final_draft.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control A1.2 word for word. It is owned by security@harborlight.example and valid until 2027-11-18. It only covers production databases. If the customer is also asking about backups of other systems, we have no approved wording for that.

answer:6168c948-aa3e-4477-8bc8-5c5070b5e: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:84022ce3-e31b-42c4-a421-007cd8f3f: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:9bb6c9e6-7e55-4ee9-b335-f0a05e56d: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:ef778f81-52ef-48cd-a150-55a2883b5: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:46b7f5d8-9cdb-4e52-b36e-3e0547840: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
